releaseTitle: ATalk v3.14.0 — Granular User-Controlled Notification Hub, Master State Control (Active/Mute/Stop), Live Lock Screen Simulator & Custom Decoy Engine
releaseNotes:
• 01 Granular Master Notification State Control: Complete 3-state control giving users total sovereignty over alert delivery: Active (Continue normal alerts), Mute (with quick-select duration chips for 1h, 8h, 24h, and Indefinite with real-time remaining countdown), and Stop (completely halt all audio, vibrations, and visual banners).
• 02 Multi-Tier Display Content Granularity: Choose exactly what information appears on lock screens and system trays: Full Preview (Sender name, avatar, and message snippet), Sender Only (Sender name with 'New message'), Incognito (Total anonymity: 'ATalk Notification' and 'New encrypted message'), Stealth Camouflage Presets (Notes Cloud Sync, Android System & Battery, Calendar, Courier Tracking, Stealth Haptic Pulse), and Custom Disguise Template.
• 03 User-Defined Custom Disguise Engine: Users can now write their own custom Notification Title and Body (e.g. 'Fitness Tracker: Daily step goal completed') to completely camouflage sensitive incoming messages as innocent apps of their choice.
• 04 Real-Time Interactive Lock Screen Simulator & Instant Test Dispatch: A live preview canvas dynamically models lock screen banners in real time as options are changed, paired with a 'Send Test Notification' button that fires an immediate test alert to the Android notification shade to verify tone, cadence, and visual presentation.
• 05 Sound & Acoustic Studio with Waveform Previews: Select custom chimes (ATalk Aurora, Crystal Droplet, Cyber Synth, Minimalist Pop, System Default, and Silent) with interactive play/stop audio auditioning.
• 06 Tactile Rhythm & Vibration Studio: Choose from Default Pulse, Quick Tick (80ms), Long Alert (500ms), Double Pulse, Heartbeat Rhythm, or None, with immediate motor testing on tap.
• 07 Presentation & Delivery Controls: Fine-grained toggles for Heads-Up floating popups on screen, In-App dynamic floating cyber pill, Notify Once Until Read alert damping, and multi-color LED indicator light (Cyan, Emerald, Violet, Amber, Off).
